notes.title: Paralax Background Update (v1.0.2)
notes.content:
We added a new effect to the background across the game. We think it gives the game more depth and looks great. The patch also includes a few minor improvements and bug fixes.

- New paralax background effect that scrolls as the camera moves
- Integrate photo system with Steam photos: In game photos will now be automatically saved to your Steam account
- Cost of new zone maps from Cartographer reduced to 10 monies
- Push: Badge room updated to increase difficulty and prevent bypassing the puzzle
- Misc bug fixes
